use_cases.title: Upgrade to a Pro subscription
use_cases.description: A free account holder upgrades from the dashboard to the Pro plan through an in-app action that completes without full page navigation, records the new plan persistently on the server, confirms success in the same view, and leaves the account in the `pro` state on a fresh fetch or after reload, with no payment-processing step because the upgrade is defined here as a direct state change.
use_cases.summary: Upgrade a Free account to Pro.
use_cases.value: Moves eligible users onto the paid subscription state and ensures the upgrade is durably recorded for later use of Pro capabilities.

use_cases.title: Access Advanced Reports according to subscription plan

use_cases.summary: Use Advanced Reports with plan-based access.
use_cases.value: Delivers premium functionality to entitled users while enforcing subscription-based access control in both UI and API surfaces.
